key_terms: A nested Arrow type with named child fields, each with its own type and validity, so a missing child value differs from a missing parent record.
The offsets buffer of a list array. The size of the list at position i is offset i + 1 minus offset i, which delimits its child values.
Storing repeated values as integer indices into a dictionary of distinct values, which saves space and comparison work for low-cardinality categories.
Key-value annotations on a schema or field, such as a unit or source-system label. They document intent but do not enforce any validation.

worked_examples.title: Distinguish a null list from an empty list
worked_examples.code:
import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.compute as pc

quantities = pa.array([[2, None], [], None], type=pa.list_(pa.int64()))
print(quantities.offsets.to_pylist())
print(pc.list_value_length(quantities).to_pylist())
print(quantities.null_count, quantities.values.null_count)
worked_examples.interpretation: The offsets 0, 2, 2, 2 show that the empty list and the null list both occupy zero child slots, yet the lengths differ: zero for the empty basket and null for the unknown one. The two null counts separate a missing list from a missing element inside a list. Flattening this column before counting would erase both distinctions, so count at the list level first.

worked_examples.title: Compare dictionary columns by decoded values
worked_examples.code:
import pyarrow as pa

left = pa.array(["east", "west"]).dictionary_encode()
right = pa.array(["west", "east"]).dictionary_encode()
print(left.indices.to_pylist(), right.indices.to_pylist())
print(left.dictionary_decode().to_pylist(), right.dictionary_decode().to_pylist())
worked_examples.interpretation: Both columns store indices 0 and 1, but they decode to opposite region orders because each batch built its own dictionary. Comparing or joining on raw indices across batches would report a false match. Unify dictionaries or decode before comparison, and treat any pipeline that persists dictionary codes as stable identifiers as a defect waiting for a new batch.
